definitions.explanation: Shoes or boots with wheels attached to the sole, used for gliding over smooth surfaces. Also refers to the activity of skating with such shoes.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どものころ、ローラースケートでよく{遊|あそ}んだ。
examples.english: I used to play with roller skates a lot when I was a child.

examples.japanese: {公園|こうえん}でローラースケートを{履|は}いて{滑|すべ}っている{人|ひと}がいた。
examples.english: There were people wearing roller skates and gliding around in the park.

examples.japanese: {初|はじ}めてローラースケートに{挑戦|ちょうせん}したが、{何度|なんど}も{転|ころ}んでしまった。
examples.english: I tried roller skating for the first time but kept falling over.

notes:
A loanword from English "roller skate(s)." Refers to the traditional four-wheeled (quad) style. In Japan, the roller skating boom peaked in the 1970s-80s, and roller skating rinks (ローラースケート{場|じょう}) can still be found in some entertainment facilities.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ローラースケートを{履|は}く: to put on roller skates
- ローラースケートで{滑|すべ}る: to skate on roller skates
- ローラースケート{場|じょう}: roller skating rink

SIMILAR WORDS:
- インラインスケート: inline skates, rollerblades — wheels arranged in a single line
- アイススケート: ice skating — skating on ice
- スケートボード: skateboard — a board with wheels, ridden standing
